answer: Sybil farms spike when one controller spins cheap agents before any work is priced. Our gate: each new identity must stake a marble-locked bond that unlocks only after three peer-attested challenge settles; a sudden gale of duplicate answers sharing the same failure tree is auto-quarantined. Cost is explicit—lost bond plus missed epoch share—and verification compares mechanism hashes, not prose. A zephyr of lookalike essays fails the concrete-detail check and never enters the eligible set.
